user.title: Connect to Microsoft Foundry
user.description: Enter a Foundry project endpoint or Azure OpenAI v1 base URL, then choose authentication.

data_description.endpoint: For example https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>. Project URLs are completed with /openai/v1 automatically.

credentials.title: Sign in to Microsoft Foundry
credentials.description: API keys can list and use models. Entra ID service principals can also list and use Foundry agents.

target.title: Select a model or agent
target.description: Available targets were loaded from the configured endpoint. Custom values must use model:<name> or agent:<name>.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Microsoft Foundry credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The configured credentials were rejected. Enter valid credentials.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Microsoft Foundry
reconfigure.description: Update the endpoint and authentication method.

reconfigure_credentials.title: Update Microsoft Foundry credentials
reconfigure_credentials.description: Enter credentials to discover and select available models and agents.

reconfigure_target.title: Select a model or agent
reconfigure_target.description: Available targets were loaded from the configured endpoint. Custom values must use model:<name> or agent:<name>.

init.title: Microsoft Foundry conversation options
init.description: Select a model or agent. Home Assistant control and model parameters apply only to model targets; Foundry agents use their stored instructions and tools.

data_description.prompt: Replaces the default Home Assistant assistant prompt. Assist API tool instructions are still appended.
data_description.temperature: Clear this field to omit temperature. It is also omitted when reasoning is active.
data_description.reasoning_effort: Disabled omits the reasoning parameter entirely.
